verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms https://supabase.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key. Supabase's own llms.txt lists it as the official "OpenAPI 3.0 description of the Management API" for organizations, projects, branches and configuration, so an agent can discover and download it directly. Missing for 10: evidence of a downloadable machine-readable spec for each project's auto-generated data (REST/GraphQL) API, beyond TypeScript type generation.
